name: Scheduled Castes Unsalaried Credit Co-operative Society and Credit and Supply Co-operative Scheme for Providing Managerial Assistance and Computer–Furniture to the Society
benefit: - **Managerial Assistance:** A maximum of ₹8,000/- per month is provided for an employee's salary, totaling Rs. 0.96 lakh per society on an annual basis.- **Computer and Furniture Assistance:** A maximum of Rs. 0.62 lakh per society is provided for the purchase of computers and furniture.
_eligibility_text: - The society must be registered under the Co-operative Act. - The society must be a Scheduled Caste Savings and Credit Co-operative Society. - The society should be formed exclusively by members belonging to the Scheduled Castes. - The applicant society must be registered within the last three financial years prior to the application year.
